intro.en: Learn to ask where someone lives, and whether they live in a house or an apartment. أَسْكُنُ means "I live" and تَسْكُنُ means "you live".
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke kisi se poochna ke woh kahan rehta hai aur ghar mein ya flat mein. أَسْكُنُ (askunu) ka matlab "main rehta hoon" aur تَسْكُنُ (taskunu) ka matlab "aap rehte hain".
intro.ar: تَتَعَلَّمُ كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ عَنْ مَكانِ سَكَنِ الشَّخْص، وَهَلْ يَسْكُنُ في بَيْتٍ أَوْ شَقَّة. أَسْكُنُ تَعْني أَنا أُقيم، وَتَسْكُنُ تَعْني أَنْتَ تُقيم.

dialogue.en: Peace be upon you.
And upon you be peace.
Where do you live?

dialogue.ar: أَسْكُنُ في حَيِّ المَطارِ. وَأَيْنَ تَسْكُنُ أَنْتَ؟
dialogue.tr: askunu fī ḥayyi l-maṭār. wa ayna taskunu anta?
dialogue.en: I live in the Airport District. And where do you live?
dialogue.ur: Main Airport ke muhalle mein rehta hoon. Aur aap kahan rehte hain?

dialogue.en: I live in the University District.
dialogue.ur: Main University ke muhalle mein rehta hoon.

dialogue.en: Do you live in a house?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ghar mein rehte hain?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، أَسْكُنُ في بَيْتٍ. وَهَلْ تَسْكُنُ في بَيْتٍ؟
dialogue.tr: naʿam, askunu fī bayt. wa hal taskunu fī bayt?
dialogue.en: Yes, I live in a house. And do you live in a house?
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, main ghar mein rehta hoon. Aur kya aap ghar mein rehte hain?

dialogue.en: No, I live in an apartment.
dialogue.ur: Nahin, main flat mein rehta hoon.

dialogue.en: What is your apartment number?
dialogue.ur: Aap ke flat ka number kya hai?

dialogue.en: 5. What is your house number?
dialogue.ur: 5. Aap ke ghar ka number kya hai?

q.en: What does «أَيْنَ تَسْكُنُ؟» mean?
q.ur: «أَيْنَ تَسْكُنُ؟» ka matlab kya hai?
q.ar: ما مَعْنى «أَيْنَ تَسْكُنُ؟»

options: Do you live in a house?

q.en: Which word means "apartment"?
q.ur: "Apartment / flat" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَسْكَناً في دَوْرٍ مِنْ عِمارَة؟

q.en: Which word means "house"?
q.ur: "Ghar" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَسْكَناً مُسْتَقِلّاً لِلْأُسْرَة؟

q.en: How do you say "No"?
q.ur: "Nahin" kaise kehte hain?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَقولُ «لا» عِنْدَ الرَّفْض؟

q.en: Hassan lives in an apartment. How does he say it?
q.ur: Hassan flat mein rehta hai. Woh kaise kehta hai?
q.ar: حَسَنٌ يَسْكُنُ في شَقَّة. كَيْفَ يَقولُ ذَلِك؟

intro.en: A tenant asks a landlord about an apartment: how many rooms, which floor. أُريدُ means "I want", and كَمْ and أَيُّ start questions.
intro.ur: Ek kiraye daar maalik-e-makaan se flat ke baare mein poochta hai: kitne kamre hain, kaun si manzil par hai. أُريدُ (urīdu) ka matlab "main chahta hoon" hai.
intro.ar: يَسْأَلُ مُسْتَأْجِرٌ صاحِبَ العَقارِ عَنْ شَقَّة: كَمْ غُرْفَةً فيها وَفي أَيِّ دَوْر. أُريدُ تَعْني أَرْغَبُ، وَتَبْدَأُ الأَسْئِلَةُ بِـ كَمْ وَأَيّ.

dialogue.en: Peace be upon you.
And upon you be peace.
I want an apartment, please.
We have a beautiful apartment.
dialogue.ur: Hamare paas ek khoobsurat flat hai.

dialogue.en: How many rooms are in the apartment?
There are five rooms in the apartment.
On which floor is the apartment?
dialogue.ur: Flat kaun si manzil par hai?

dialogue.en: The apartment is on the fifth floor.
I want to see the apartment.
Please, come in. This is the apartment.
dialogue.ur: Tashreef laiye, andar aaiye, yeh flat hai.

dialogue.en: This is a beautiful apartment.

q.en: What does «أُريدُ شَقَّةً» mean?
q.ur: «أُريدُ شَقَّةً» ka matlab kya hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَعْني المُتَكَلِّمُ بِقَوْلِهِ «أُريدُ شَقَّةً»؟

q.en: Which word means "room"?
q.ur: "Kamra" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني جُزْءاً مِنَ الشَّقَّةِ نَنامُ فيهِ أَوْ نَجْلِسُ؟

q.en: Which word means "beautiful"?
q.ur: "Khoobsurat" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى الجَمال؟

q.en: «في الدَّوْرِ الخامِسِ» means:
q.ur: «في الدَّوْرِ الخامِسِ» ka matlab:
q.ar: ماذا تَعْني «في الدَّوْرِ الخامِسِ»؟

q.en: The landlord says «تَفَضَّلْ، اُدْخُلْ». What does he mean?
q.ur: Maalik-e-makaan kehta hai «تَفَضَّلْ، اُدْخُلْ». Matlab kya hai?
q.ar: قالَ صاحِبُ العَقارِ: «تَفَضَّلْ، اُدْخُلْ». ماذا يَقْصِد؟

intro.en: A buyer tells a seller what furniture he needs for each room: bedroom, living room, kitchen and bathroom. ماذا تُريدُ؟ means "What do you want?"
intro.ur: Ek khareedaar bechne wale ko batata hai ke har kamre ke liye kaun sa furniture chahiye: sone ka kamra, baithak, bawarchi khana aur ghusalkhana. ماذا تُريدُ؟ ka matlab "aap kya chahte hain?" hai.
intro.ar: يُخْبِرُ المُشْتَري البائِعَ بِالأَثاثِ الَّذي يَحْتاجُهُ لِكُلِّ غُرْفَة: غُرْفَةِ النَّوْمِ وَالجُلوسِ وَالمَطْبَخِ وَالحَمّام. ماذا تُريدُ؟ سُؤالٌ عَمّا يَرْغَبُ فيهِ الشَّخْص.

dialogue.en: Peace be upon you.
And upon you be peace. How can I help?
dialogue.ur: Wa alaikum assalam. Kaise khidmat kar sakta hoon?

dialogue.en: I want some furniture.
What do you want for the bedroom?
dialogue.ur: Sone ke kamre ke liye kya chahiye?

dialogue.en: I want a bed and a curtain.
And what do you want for the living room?
dialogue.ur: Aur baithak ke liye kya chahiye?

dialogue.en: I want a sofa and a carpet.
And what do you want for the kitchen?
dialogue.ur: Aur bawarchi khane ke liye kya chahiye?

dialogue.en: I want an oven and a fridge.
And what do you want for the bathroom?
dialogue.ur: Aur ghusalkhane ke liye kya chahiye?

dialogue.en: I want a water heater and a mirror.
Do you want anything else?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap kuch aur chahte hain?

dialogue.en: Thank you, I want to look at the furniture.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya, main furniture dekhna chahta hoon.

dialogue.en: Please, go ahead.

q.en: Where do you put a bed?
q.ur: Palang kahan rakhte hain?
q.ar: في أَيِّ غُرْفَةٍ نَضَعُ السَّريرَ؟

q.en: Which word means "refrigerator"?
q.ur: "Fridge" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني الجِهازَ الَّذي نَحْفَظُ فيهِ الطَّعامَ بارِداً؟

q.en: Which word means "mirror"?
q.ur: "Aaina" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني ما نَنْظُرُ فيهِ لِنَرى وَجْهَنا؟

q.en: What does «ماذا تُريدُ؟» mean?
q.ur: «ماذا تُريدُ؟» ka matlab kya hai?
q.ar: ما مَعْنى «ماذا تُريدُ؟»

q.en: Which word means "seller"?
q.ur: "Bechne wala" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني الشَّخْصَ الَّذي يَبيعُ؟

intro.en: Learn the seven days of the week in Arabic. In this book the week starts on Saturday (السَّبْت) and ends on Friday (الجُمُعَة).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum hafte ke saat din Arabi mein seekhenge. Is kitab mein hafta Saturday (السَّبْت) se shuru hota hai aur Jumma (الجُمُعَة) par khatam hota hai.
intro.ar: تَتَعَلَّمُ أَيّامَ الأُسْبوعِ السَّبْعَةَ بِالعَرَبِيَّة. يَبْدَأُ الأُسْبوعُ في هَذا الكِتابِ بِيَوْمِ السَّبْتِ وَيَنْتَهي بِيَوْمِ الجُمُعَة.

q.en: Which day comes right after السَّبْت (Saturday)?
q.ur: السَّبْت (Saturday) ke baad kaun sa din aata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ يَوْمٍ يَأْتي بَعْدَ السَّبْت؟

q.en: Which word means "Friday"?
q.ur: "Jumma" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى آخِرِ يَوْمٍ في الأُسْبوعِ في هَذا الكِتاب؟

q.en: Which word means "Thursday"?
q.ur: "Jumeraat" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى اليَوْمِ الَّذي بَعْدَ الأَرْبِعاء؟

q.en: Which day comes before الأَرْبِعاء (Wednesday)?
q.ur: الأَرْبِعاء (Budh) se pehle kaun sa din hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ يَوْمٍ يَأْتي قَبْلَ الأَرْبِعاء؟

q.en: Which word means "Sunday"?
q.ur: "Itwaar" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى ثاني أَيّامِ الأُسْبوعِ في هَذا الكِتاب؟

intro.en: Practise ready-made sentence patterns by swapping words: هَلْ تَسْكُنُ في ...؟ (Do you live in ...?), أُريدُ ... (I want ...), كَمْ ... في الشَّقَّةِ؟ (How many ... in the apartment?).
intro.ur: Taiyaar jumlon ke saanche seekhte hain, bas lafz badalte jayen: هَلْ تَسْكُنُ في ...؟ (Kya aap ... mein rehte hain?), أُريدُ ... (Mujhe ... chahiye), كَمْ ... في الشَّقَّةِ؟ (Flat mein kitne ... hain?).
intro.ar: تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى جُمَلٍ جاهِزَةٍ بِتَبْديلِ الكَلِمات: هَلْ تَسْكُنُ في ...؟ وَأُريدُ ... وَكَمْ ... في الشَّقَّةِ؟

vocab.en: Do you live in a house?
vocab.ur: Kya aap ghar mein rehte hain?

vocab.en: Yes, I live in a house
vocab.ur: Ji haan, main ghar mein rehta hoon

vocab.en: How many rooms in the apartment?
There are three rooms in the apartment
The apartment is on the third floor

vocab.ur: Hamare paas ek khoobsurat ghar hai

vocab.en: On which floor is the apartment?
vocab.ur: Flat kaun si manzil par hai?

q.en: Choose the correct question: "Do you live in a house?"
q.ur: Sahi sawal chunein: "Kya aap ghar mein rehte hain?"
q.ar: اخْتَرِ السُّؤالَ الصَّحيحَ لِتَسْأَلَ: هَلْ تَسْكُنُ في بَيْت؟

q.en: Which sentence means "I want an apartment, please"?
q.ur: Kaun sa jumla hai "Mujhe flat chahiye, meherbani"?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تُفيدُ طَلَبَ شَقَّةٍ بِأَدَب؟

q.en: Which word asks "how many"?
q.ur: "Kitne" poochne ka lafz kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ نَسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ العَدَد؟

q.en: «الشَّقَّةُ في الدَّوْرِ الثّالِثِ» means:
q.ur: «الشَّقَّةُ في الدَّوْرِ الثّالِثِ» ka matlab:
q.ar: ماذا تَعْني «الشَّقَّةُ في الدَّوْرِ الثّالِثِ»؟

options: The apartment is on the third floor

q.en: Which sentence means "We have a beautiful apartment"?
q.ur: Kaun sa jumla hai "Hamare paas khoobsurat flat hai"?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تُفيدُ أَنَّ عِنْدَنا شَقَّةً جَميلَة؟

title.en: Sounds: the letter ح and listening
title.ur: Awaazein: harf ح aur sun kar samajhna

intro.en: Listen carefully to the letter ح (ḥ), a deep breathy sound made in the throat, and tell it apart from ه (h), which is light. Then listen and match what you hear with the pictures.
intro.ur: Harf ح (ḥ) ko dhyan se suniye. Yeh gale ki gehrai se nikalta hai. Isay halki aawaz wale ه (h) se alag pehchaniye. Phir sun kar tasveeron se milayen.
intro.ar: أَصْغِ جَيِّداً إلى الحَرْفِ ح، وَهُوَ صَوْتٌ عَميقٌ يَخْرُجُ مِنَ الحَلْق، وَمَيِّزْهُ عَنِ الحَرْفِ ه الخَفيف. ثُمَّ اسْتَمِعْ وَطابِقْ ما تَسْمَعُهُ بِالصُّوَر.

q.en: Which word starts with the letter ح?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz harf ح se shuru hota hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَبْدَأُ بِالحَرْفِ ح؟

q.en: Which word contains the letter ح?
q.ur: Kaun se lafz mein harf ح hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ فيها الحَرْفُ ح؟

q.en: Which word is "bathroom"?
q.ur: "Bathroom" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني المَكانَ الَّذي نَغْتَسِلُ فيهِ؟

q.en: The letter ح sounds:
q.ur: Harf ح ki aawaz kaisi hai?
q.ar: كَيْفَ يُنْطَقُ الحَرْفُ ح؟

options: Deep and breathy, from the throat

q.en: Which letter is the light "h" sound?
q.ur: Halki "h" ki aawaz kaun sa harf hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ هُوَ صَوْتُ الهاءِ الخَفيف؟

intro.en: Practise with a friend: ask for each other's house or apartment number, say which district you live in, and ask to see rooms and furniture.
intro.ur: Dost ke saath mashq karein: ek dusre ke ghar ya flat ka number poochein, batayein kis muhalle mein rehte hain, aur kamre ya furniture dekhne ko kahen.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ صَديقِكَ: اسْأَلْهُ عَنْ رَقْمِ بَيْتِهِ أَوْ شَقَّتِهِ، وَقُلْ في أَيِّ حَيٍّ تَسْكُن، وَاطْلُبْ رُؤْيَةَ الغُرَفِ وَالأَثاث.

vocab.ur: Aap ke ghar ka number kya hai?
Aap ke flat ka number kya hai?

vocab.en: I live in the University District
vocab.ur: Main University ke muhalle mein rehta hoon

vocab.en: I want to see the apartment

q.en: How do you ask a friend for their house number?
q.ur: Dost se ghar ka number kaise poochte hain?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ صَديقَكَ عَنْ رَقْمِ بَيْتِهِ؟

q.en: How do you ask where someone lives?
q.ur: Kisi se poochna ke woh kahan rehta hai:
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ عَنْ مَكانِ سَكَنِ شَخْصٍ؟

q.en: You want to see the apartment. You say:
q.ur: Aap flat dekhna chahte hain. Aap kehte hain:
q.ar: تُريدُ أَنْ تَرى الشَّقَّةَ. ماذا تَقول؟

q.en: The answer to «أَيْنَ تَسْكُنُ؟» could be:
q.ur: «أَيْنَ تَسْكُنُ؟» ka jawab ho sakta hai:
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَصْلُحُ جَواباً عَنْ «أَيْنَ تَسْكُنُ؟»

intro.en: Look, listen and read the words and short sentences about the house, then read the short paragraph about Ahmad's apartment and answer the questions.
intro.ur: Dekhiye, suniye aur ghar ke baare mein lafz aur chhote jumle parhiye. Phir Ahmad ke flat ka chhota paragraph parh kar sawalon ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: انْظُرْ وَاسْتَمِعْ وَاقْرَأِ الكَلِماتِ وَالجُمَلَ القَصيرَةَ عَنِ البَيْت، ثُمَّ اقْرَأْ فِقْرَةَ شَقَّةِ أَحْمَدَ وَأَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَة.

vocab.en: The apartment is on the first floor
I want to see the kitchen
vocab.ur: Main bawarchi khana dekhna chahta hoon

q.en: Read: «أَسْكُنُ في بَيْتٍ». What does it mean?
q.ur: Parhiye: «أَسْكُنُ في بَيْتٍ». Matlab kya hai?
q.ar: اقْرَأْ: «أَسْكُنُ في بَيْتٍ». ماذا تَعْني؟

q.en: Read: «في الشَّقَّةِ ثَلاثُ غُرَفٍ». How many rooms?
q.ur: Parhiye: «في الشَّقَّةِ ثَلاثُ غُرَفٍ». Kitne kamre hain?
q.ar: اقْرَأْ: «في الشَّقَّةِ ثَلاثُ غُرَفٍ». كَمْ غُرْفَةً فيها؟

q.en: In the paragraph, where is Ahmad's apartment?
q.ur: Paragraph mein Ahmad ka flat kahan hai?
q.ar: في الفِقْرَةِ، أَيْنَ شَقَّةُ أَحْمَد؟

options: In the Airport District, third floor
In the University District, first floor
In the Airport District, fifth floor
options_ar: في حَيِّ المَطار، في الدَّوْرِ الثّالِث
في حَيِّ الجامِعَة، في الدَّوْرِ الأَوَّل
في حَيِّ المَطار، في الدَّوْرِ الخامِس

q.en: In Ahmad's apartment, what is in the kitchen?
q.ur: Ahmad ke flat ke bawarchi khane mein kya hai?
q.ar: في شَقَّةِ أَحْمَدَ، ماذا يُوجَدُ في المَطْبَخ؟

q.en: Read: «الشَّقَّةُ في الدَّوْرِ الأَوَّلِ». Which floor?
q.ur: Parhiye: «الشَّقَّةُ في الدَّوْرِ الأَوَّلِ». Kaun si manzil?
q.ar: اقْرَأْ: «الشَّقَّةُ في الدَّوْرِ الأَوَّلِ». في أَيِّ دَوْر؟

title.en: Writing: ج ح خ and ع غ
title.ur: Likhna: ج ح خ aur ع غ

intro.en: Practise writing the letters ج (j), ح (ḥ), خ (kh), then ع (ʿ) and غ (gh) in their different shapes: alone, at the start, middle and end of a word. Dots matter!
intro.ur: Harf ج (j)، ح (ḥ)، خ (kh) aur phir ع (ʿ) aur غ (gh) likhne ki mashq karein, alag alag shakal mein: akela, shuru, beech aur aakhir mein. Nuqton ka dhyan rakhein!
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى كِتابَةِ الحُروفِ ج ح خ ثُمَّ ع غ بِأَشْكالِها: مُنْفَرِدَةً وَفي أَوَّلِ الكَلِمَةِ وَوَسَطِها وَآخِرِها. النُّقَطُ مُهِمَّة!

q.en: Which letter has one dot below?
q.ur: Kis harf ke neeche ek nuqta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ فيهِ نُقْطَةٌ واحِدَةٌ تَحْتَه؟

q.en: Which letter has no dot at all?
q.ur: Kis harf par bilkul nuqta nahin?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ لا نُقْطَةَ فيهِ؟

q.en: Which letter has one dot above?
q.ur: Kis harf ke upar ek nuqta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ فَوْقَهُ نُقْطَةٌ واحِدَة؟

q.en: Which word starts with غ?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz غ se shuru hota hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَبْدَأُ بِالحَرْفِ غ؟

q.en: Which word starts with ع?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz ع se shuru hota hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَبْدَأُ بِالحَرْفِ ع؟
